name: Hating People
overview: Scripture reveals that hatred toward others is rooted in wickedness and violence, which God’s soul hates, as seen in Psalms 11:5. The Old Testament warns against pride and shedding innocent blood, attitudes closely linked to hatred (Proverbs 6:17). Jesus teaches a higher standard, instructing believers to love their neighbors as themselves (Luke 10:27) rather than seeking retaliation, emphasizing mercy over 'an eye for an eye' justice (Matthew 5:38, 26:52). True service to God involves joyfulness and gladness, contrasting with the bitterness that fuels hatred (Deuteronomy 28:47).
